name: performance-pack
title: Campaign performance pack
for_each: select id,name from workspaces order by name

sections.title: Results
sections.note: Platform-reported attribution, not audited revenue or unique customers. Do not add currencies.
sections.sql: select campaign,currency,spend,conversions,revenue,cpa,roas,latest_day from campaign_performance where workspace_id=$1 order by campaign

sections.title: Pacing
sections.note: Linear budget profile. Adjust flight dates and budget before using an imported campaign.
sections.sql: select campaign,currency,budget,expected_spend,spend,pace_variance,remaining from campaign_pacing where workspace_id=$1 order by campaign

name: claim-evidence
title: Claim evidence record
for_each: select id,statement as name from claims order by created_at

sections.title: Evidence requiring human review
sections.sql: select statement,evidence,review_due,reviewed_by from claims where id=$1

name: data-review
title: Data purpose and retention review
for_each: select id,name from workspaces order by name

sections.title: Recorded review
sections.note: The review date is an internal reminder, not a statutory retention period.
sections.sql: select name,currency,owner,purpose,review_due from workspaces where id=$1
